title: [E-Document] Add AKV switch for PA LLM calls (29.x)
summary: E-Document AI processing now supports switching between different LLM models for PA-related calls through Azure Key Vault configuration to facilitate model migration.
key_points: Adds AKV-based switching mechanism for LLM model selection in E-Document processing
Enables configuration of alternative models for PA-related AI calls
Prepares infrastructure for upcoming model migration without code changes
Affects AI Tool Processor and MLLM Handler components
quote: Adding a mechanism to switch the model being called for PA-related E-Document-owned LLM calls to prepare for the upcoming migration.
